subject: Kickoff: Didi digital-ink benchmark hosting
body:
Ivo, team,

Kicking off the Didi benchmark track. The dataset gives us digital ink drawings of diagrams with full dynamic drawing information -- stroke timing included -- collected via prompted drawing sessions, with the prompts available in png, dot, and xdot form. That combination (ink + ground-truth graph structure) is rare, and it is the right substrate for the interactive diagram-understanding features the notes product wants.

Goal for this short window: host the dataset internally on Corpus, ship the TFRecord conversion path from the reference notebook as a supported pipeline, train a baseline model on the paper's train/validation/test split, and give researchers a standard way to compare results.

Milestones: data hosted March 13, pipeline + baseline April 10, wrap May 8.

Dmitri
